name: Spaceship e08df0a8 on 3.6.3.6
description: A period-4 spaceship on the trihexagonal (kagome) tiling 3.6.3.6 (touching neighbours), 10 to 13 cells, moving one lattice step every 4 generations (c/4). It runs the same way in the 4,096 rules from B36/S23 to B3,6,7,8,9,10,11,12/S2,3,6,7,9,10,11,12; the scene uses the rule it was found in. Found by JETCARP's soup search (seen 2 times). A derivative ship (Guttesen's kagome glider g with a tag-along): kept as a distinct object, not counted as a discovery. Flagged as most likely already known: built on Guttesen's kagome glider g; runs in HighLife (B36/S23) on an Archimedean tiling. We found no earlier report, but others may well have seen it, so it is not claimed.
